# Tool Release Checklist

> Complete this checklist before merging or deploying any new tool.

---

# Tool Information

Tool Name:

Category:

Primary Keyword:

Supporting Keywords:

Tool PRD:

Owner:

Status:

---

# User Experience

- [ ] Purpose is immediately clear
- [ ] H1 is descriptive
- [ ] Hero description is concise
- [ ] Workspace appears above the fold on desktop
- [ ] Mobile layout verified
- [ ] Desktop layout verified
- [ ] Tablet layout verified
- [ ] Empty state implemented
- [ ] Helpful onboarding text included
- [ ] Related Tools section added
- [ ] FAQ section added
- [ ] Footer matches design system

---

# Functionality

- [ ] Paste input works
- [ ] File upload works (if applicable)
- [ ] Drag & Drop works (if applicable)
- [ ] Sample data works
- [ ] Copy output works
- [ ] Download output works
- [ ] Clear button works
- [ ] Reset button works
- [ ] Undo/Redo works (if applicable)
- [ ] All toolbar actions verified
- [ ] Output matches expected results
- [ ] No data corruption

---

# Validation & Error Handling

- [ ] Empty input handled
- [ ] Invalid input handled
- [ ] Error messages explain:
  - [ ] What happened
  - [ ] Why
  - [ ] How to fix it
- [ ] Success messages displayed
- [ ] Edge cases tested

---

# Performance

- [ ] Client-side processing confirmed
- [ ] No unnecessary network requests
- [ ] Large file tested
- [ ] Browser remains responsive
- [ ] Progress indicator shown when appropriate
- [ ] No memory leaks observed

---

# Accessibility

- [ ] Semantic HTML
- [ ] Keyboard navigation
- [ ] Visible focus states
- [ ] Screen reader labels
- [ ] Color contrast verified
- [ ] Forms accessible
- [ ] Images include alt text where needed

---

# Responsive Testing

## Mobile

- [ ] 375px
- [ ] 390px
- [ ] 430px

## Tablet

- [ ] 768px

## Desktop

- [ ] 1024px
- [ ] 1280px
- [ ] 1440px+

# Browser Testing

- [ ] Chrome
- [ ] Firefox
- [ ] Edge
- [ ] Safari (if possible)

---

# SEO

- [ ] Unique Title
- [ ] Meta Description
- [ ] Canonical URL
- [ ] Open Graph tags
- [ ] Twitter tags
- [ ] Structured Data validated
- [ ] FAQ Schema validated
- [ ] Internal links added
- [ ] Related tools added
- [ ] Keyword placement reviewed
- [ ] Sitemap updated (if required)

---

# Quality

- [ ] No console errors
- [ ] No TypeScript errors
- [ ] No build warnings
- [ ] Production build passes
- [ ] Lighthouse checked
- [ ] Broken links checked
- [ ] Analytics verified
- [ ] Documentation updated

---

# Final Review

- [ ] Tool follows Master PRD
- [ ] Design System followed
- [ ] Tool Standards followed
- [ ] Approved for release
